description: banker hooks for the Codex plugin (codex plugin add banker@banker-plugins), written by scripts/sync-codex-plugin.js. Codex reads this file instead of hooks/hooks.json because .codex-plugin/plugin.json names it. update notice (SessionStart, opt-out BANKER_NO_UPDATE_CHECK), usage counting (Stop, opt-out BANKER_NO_TELEMETRY), obsidizer wiki canonicalization (PostToolUse Bash, inert until obsidizer --enable writes omx_wiki/.obsidizer; it runs node once per shell call, so leave it untrusted if you do not use obsidizer). Codex runs them only after you trust them in /hooks, and outside its sandbox: each command runs the node PATH names only when its real path is absolute and outside the temp folder and the session folder. command is for sh, commandWindows for PowerShell; PLUGIN_ROOT is the installed plugin folder.

hooks.command: [ -n "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || exit 0; n=$(command -v node) || exit 0; r=$(realpath "$n" 2>/dev/null || readlink -f "$n" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; u=$(cd /tmp && pwd -P); t=$(cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" 2>/dev/null && pwd -P) || t=$u; p=$(pwd -P); case "$r" in "$u"/*|"$t"/*|"$p"/*) exit 0;; /*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; "$r" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/run.cjs" "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
hooks.commandWindows: if (-not $env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; $n = Get-Command node -CommandType Application -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { exit 0 }; $r = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($n.Source); foreach ($d in @($env:TEMP, $env:TMP, "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Temp", $PWD.Path)) { if ($d -and $r.StartsWith($d.TrimEnd('\') + '\', 'OrdinalIgnoreCase')) { exit 0 } }; & $r "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\run.cjs" "$env:PLUGIN_ROOT\hooks\update-notify.mjs" --codex --plugin
